'''Deggar Feps''' was a rogue [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who had a knack for getting himself into difficult situations.

==Biography==
Sometime during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Deggar visited the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. Some way or another, he managed to anger [[Sonnos]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], while visiting his personal residence. Deggar hoped to escape from the Hutt's wrath by hitching a ride on the space barge ''[[Lost Lady]]'', bound for [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], but was intercepted by the spy droid [[NEK-01]] in mid-flight. A fierce fight took place, and NEK-01 managed to plant a homing beacon aboard the ship. A group of bounty hunters soon arrived, and began firing at the ''[[Lost Lady]]''. Deggar and a group of mercenaries then worked out a deal; Deggar would provide the mercenaries with information on Sotto's dealings, provided that the mercenaries safely get him off of Nal Hutta. After destroying the homing beacon and evading the bounty hunters, Deggar Feps, along with everyone else aboard the ''Lost Lady'', made it safely to the nearby [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of Nar Shaddaa.

==Skills and abilities==
He was fluent in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Mon Calamari (language)|Calamari]] [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], and [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]].<ref name="Nebula Assassin" />
